title: Electricity 2026 — Executive Summary and Demand
claim: Global electricity demand is forecast to grow 3.6% a year over 2026-2030, about 50% faster than the previous decade average; global data-centre consumption rises from 415 TWh in 2024 to roughly 945 TWh in 2030, with data-centre demand up 17% in 2025 and AI-focused data centres up 50%.

title: Annual Energy Outlook 2026
claim: US electricity demand is projected to grow 0.9%-1.6% a year through 2050 across cases, against 2.1% annually over the past five years; installed generating capacity rises 50%-90% by 2050. title: Hyperscaler capex run-rate against full-year guidance
claim: Q1 2026 combined capital expenditure of $129.8B annualises to $519B, materially below the roughly $725B full-year aggregate reported in the press.
